input.brief: CodeKiln desktop AI coding workbench main window: icon rail, session sidebar, chat timeline, right side panel
screens: Main workbench: app rail + project sidebar + chat timeline with composer + right side panel

stated.mood: faithful restoration of the existing app UI
stated.colour: dark Kettu theme with fox orange accent
stated.emphasis: density and information structure of the real workbench

obvious: Dark slate app shell with indigo accent, Inter, white rounded cards on #0f1117, three-column layout with a left nav list.

proposals.name: Kettu 狐狸橙
proposals.idea: On these screens, the workbench's own floating card geometry — a 56px icon rail and three gap-separated rounded panels on one shell ground — becomes the layout skeleton.
proposals.departs: Restores the app's own Kettu dark tokens instead of a generated indigo/slate shell.
proposals.layout: 56px icon rail at far left; project sidebar card; chat card with a timeline of tool rows and a bordered composer; right side-panel card. Nothing is a full-bleed column.

devices.reason: CodeKiln's timeline shows file paths, shell commands and diffs as the actual content; monospace is the product's material, not decoration.
The shell sets 13px interface type against 11px secondary rows; the density is the product's signature and needs a real size step.

proposals.name: 深海蓝
proposals.idea: On these screens, the running-state indicators — the spark row and the rail's spinner counts — become the only saturated thing on screen.
proposals.departs: Cools the whole surface toward blue-grey and hands the accent to ocean blue; the card geometry and density stay.
proposals.layout: Same rail + three-card skeleton, but the sidebar loses its tone step and reads as one flat plane with the shell.

devices.reason: Commands and paths remain the dominant texture of the timeline.

proposals.name: 纸白青
proposals.idea: On these screens, the 1px hairline the app uses instead of shadows becomes the only layer device — white cards on a #f8f8f8 desk, no elevation anywhere.
proposals.departs: Flips to the app's own light palette and drops the orange for teal; the card seams stay.
proposals.layout: Rail and three white cards separated by hairlines and the 6px seam; the sidebar uses a grey pill for the active row rather than a tinted fill.

devices.reason: Tool rows, paths and commands stay monospace; on a white ground the monospace columns carry the density.
